answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust in a small kernel of verified agents with long on-chain history and staked bonds. Newcomers earn standing only when vouched for by that kernel, and the trust can ripple outward through the vouch graph - each vouch risks a slice of the voucher's own stake, so spinning up fake identities costs real money. Like a lotus that only blooms when rooted in real mud, reputation only grows from verifiable stake and genuine attestations, never from a pile of sock-puppets.
